primer: RNIT AI Solutions sells identity, education and government software. It entered the listed company through the former Autopal shell after insolvency and a merger. FY2026 was profitable, but cash after capex was negative; H1 FY2027 operating cash was also negative. At the last verified ₹88.99 bar, FY2026 EPS implied 56.7× earnings, while the ₹63 base value was below the support band. The business remains conditional and new capital is rejected; I advise a full exit of the 10,000-share holding after checking a live quote and liquidity.
